enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Moves arm. Slight snoring. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Turns on tap. Applies soap. Rubs hands. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns on tap. Washes face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and bread. Closes refrigerator. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Presses kettle switch. Cracks eggs into bowl. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours eggs into pan. Stirs eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Places eggs on plate. Toasts bread. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks tea. Clears dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag and laptop for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Takes out clothes from wardrobe. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens bag. Places laptop into bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks out of apartment. Closes door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks to office. Enters office building. Greets receptionist. Walks to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email client. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Makes phone calls. Talks to colleagues. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Drafts program plan. Prints documents. Files documents. Organizes files.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to café. Opens door. Orders sandwich. Pays. Receives sandwich. Finds table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Checks phone. Reads news. Stands up. Throws trash. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, meeting community partners and planning upcoming events
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Reviews event plan. Calls community partner. Discusses logistics. Sends emails. Updates spreadsheet. Prints flyers. Meets with team. Brainstorms ideas. Writes notes. Makes schedule. Confirms venue. Orders supplies.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters building. Walks to apartment. Unlocks door. Enters apartment. Closes door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Cuts chicken. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds chicken. Stirs chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs vegetables. Adds sauce. Turns off induction cooker. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Scrapes food into trash. Rinses dishes. Loads dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Presses start. Wipes counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches news. Watches show. Adjusts volume. Stands up. Gets snack. Sits back down. Eats snack. Watches more TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up cushions. Fluffs cushions. Places cushions on sofa. Picks up magazines. Stacks magazines. Places on shelf. Picks up trash. Throws trash in bin. Opens closet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum. Turns on vacuum. Vacuums floor. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs vacuum. Winds cord. Puts vacuum back. Closes closet.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer under the desk lamp to check personal emails and read
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens browser. Reads news. Watches video. Closes browser. Opens ebook. Reads book. Closes ebook. Shuts down laptop. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, washing up and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Applies cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.
Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Moves arm. Slight snoring. Remains asleep.
